notes: Right-click selected text in an email to copy, translate or search Google. Cmd+click an email address to look it up on Google, or a plain-text web address to open it. The shortcuts button now sits next to the settings cog. Fixed the missing track name on the song page and the cramped Artist Web Search card.
mac_notes: Right-click selected text in an email to copy, translate or search Google. Cmd+click an email address to look it up on Google, or a plain-text web address to open it. The shortcuts button now sits next to the settings cog. Fixed the missing track name on the song page and the cramped Artist Web Search card.
windows_notes: You can now right-click selected text in an email to copy it, translate it or search Google, and Ctrl+click an email address to look it up. The shortcuts button now sits next to the settings cog on every tab. Fixed the track name missing from the song page when opened from an artist's profile, and the Artist Web Search card running out of room.
